# QQD declared the way the refusal says to declare it.
#
# `QQD` is not an ISO 4217 code, so GnuCash has no such currency: declared in
# the CURRENCY namespace it writes a commodity with no name and no fraction,
# saves, and will not reload. The refusal for that says the unit belongs in a
# stock or fund namespace instead — and this fixture is that sentence taken
# literally, so the route the reader is sent down is known to work rather than
# merely recommended.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_currency_must_be_one_gnucash_knows.py.
2024-01-01 commodity QQD
	mnemonic: "QQD"
	fullname: "Q Fund"
	namespace: "FUND"
	fraction: 100
